Delete an Other Input Type

User manual · English · 8 steps
Learn how to delete an input type that is no longer used on payslips.

1. Open Payroll

Open the Payroll app.

2. Configuration menu

Open the Configuration menu.

3. Other Input Types

Click Other Input Types.

4. Find the input type

Type the name of the input type and press Enter.

5. Select it

Tick the box in front of the input type.

6. Actions

Click Actions.

7. Delete

Click Delete.

8. Confirm

Click Delete in the window to confirm.
